reasoning_content: The docker containers are running but there's no areloria container. Let me search for any areloria container or check if it's under a different name.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# List all containers
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' 2>&1")
print("All:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check for areloria or game containers
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("docker ps -a 2>&1 | grep -i -E 'areloria|game|server' | head -5")
print("Game:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
